emails.body_text:
Hey Donald,

I was looking at advantageroofingtx.com and respected seeing a 3rd-generation Houston roofer still standing behind hand-nailed installations.

One conversion leak jumped out: mobile homeowners hit a plain 5-field callback form with no way to preview a Gulf Coast replacement range or compare wind-rated shingle versus standing seam metal first.

So I built a working 30-second Houston Roof Estimator in your crimson-and-sandstone Advantage Roofing branding. Homeowners tap their size, slope, and wind-rated material to see a real ballpark before leaving their name and phone.

Mind if I send over the live preview link?

— {{sender_name}}

{{sender_address}} | {{unsubscribe_line}}

objection_handlers.objection: Hand-nailed craftsmanship costs more than nail-gun chuck-in-a-truck quotes — won't online pricing hurt us?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: It actually protects your margin. By calibrating the estimator to real Gulf Coast wind-rated craftsmanship ($13.8k–$45k+), bargain-basement tire-kickers filter themselves out before calling, while homeowners who value quality book already comfortable with your pricing.

objection_handlers.objection: We already get solid word-of-mouth referrals around Katy and West Houston.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: 3rd-generation referrals are unbeatable — and even referred neighbors still pull up advantageroofingtx.com on their phone at 8pm before calling. Giving them a 30-second estimator captures those ready-to-buy visitors who prefer seeing a ballpark before picking up the phone.

objection_handlers.objection: Why pay $750 setup + $149/mo when we already have a contact form?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Your static 5-field form gives zero price context and misses storm urgency. This drops right onto your homepage, flags active leaks and hail claims into your priority slot, includes quarterly Houston material updates, and one extra closed replacement pays for 3+ years.

objection_handlers.objection: I don't want anyone redesigning or breaking our current site.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Zero redesign needed. It's a single 28 KB vanilla JS script wrapped in Shadow DOM isolation so it cannot touch any existing page styles or add speed lag — and we'll give your web guy the lazy-load fix for your 21 homepage images free of charge.
